metadata.name: seal.lock
metadata.description: (password?) - Layer-2 at-rest seal. With a password: derive a data key (PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA-256) and install the kernel seal hooks so SEALED segment cels encrypt (AES-256-GCM) on dehydrate and decrypt on hydrate. With no/empty arg: clear the hooks (re-lock) - sealed values stay ciphertext at rest and unreadable on load. The password and data key never become cel values and never enter an archive.

metadata.name: seal.locked
metadata.description: () - true when this state is locked (no seal cipher hook installed).
